content.task: Generate exactly 5 highly personalized {{targetLanguage}} practice scenarios based on the user's current life context
output_rules: Return ONLY a valid JSON array with exactly 5 objects
No markdown, no explanation, no wrapping
All scenario content must be in {{targetLanguage}}

schema.title: Short scenario title, 5-8 words
schema.description: 1-2 sentences with SPECIFIC details: real names, places, numbers, concrete stakes

personalization_rules: Base scenarios on their CURRENT job, project, upcoming event, or recent interest
Each scenario should address a real situation they're likely to face soon
No scenario should be generic — if you could use it for anyone, make it more specific
specificity_rules: Use their actual job title and realistic work situations
Reference their upcoming event or project explicitly where relevant
Include a concrete goal they must accomplish (negotiate, explain, request, describe)
Add realistic constraints (time pressure, language barrier, technical detail to convey)
Example BAD: 'Discussing a Project at Work' — too vague
Example GOOD: 'Explaining Backend Deployment Delay to a French Client in a Video Call' — specific person, specific problem
